# verify/solve/replay

`verify/solve/replay` — re-evaluates, without z3, each input z3 says breaks
a program: a counterexample to an ensures clause, an input that reaches a
hazard, a witness of `vector diff`. The evaluator is exact: an Int is an
integer and a Real a rational, each part an i64, and every step is the one
`verify/smt/script` emits, callee guards and short-circuit paths included.

A replay ends one of three ways. `confirmed`: the input does what z3 said.
`mismatch`: it does not, so the encoding and the program disagree, which is
a bug in vector. `not-replayed`: the replay could not decide, because a
value is not one it reads, a step leaves i64, or a value depends on a
division by zero, which z3 leaves unspecified. Only a mismatch changes a
verdict.

Generated from [src/verify/solve/replay.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/verify/solve/replay.ts).

### replayParseValue

Reads a model value: `true` or `false`, a number as vector renders it
(`5`, `-5`, `1.5`, `1/3`, `-1/3`), or as z3 prints it (`(- 5)`, `(/ 1 3)`,
`(/ (- 1) 3)`, `(- (/ 1 3))`). Anything else, such as a `root-obj`, and a
number whose parts leave i64, is unknown.

```ts
function replayParseValue(text: string): ReplayValue
```

<scalar-field name="text" type="string" required>

the value

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="ReplayValue">

the value, unknown with why when it cannot be read

</scalar-field>

### replayEvaluate

Evaluates a function at an input, as the verification script does: each
requires on the path of the ones before it, then the body on the path of
them all, recording the hazards reached.

```ts
function replayEvaluate(
  program: Program,
  fn: FnUnit,
  names: string[],
  values: string[],
): ReplayRun
```

<scalar-field name="program" type="Program" required>

the program the function belongs to

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="fn" type="FnUnit" required>

the function

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="names" type="string[]" required>

the parameters' names, by position of `fn.params` (`values` at the same index)

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="values" type="string[]" required>

each parameter's value

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="ReplayRun">

the run; `unbound` is set when a value is missing or unreadable

</scalar-field>

### replayClause

Replays a refuted ensures clause: confirmed when every requires holds at
the counterexample, the body returns z3's result there (when it gave one),

### replayHazard

Replays a hazard: confirmed when the input reaches it and its condition
holds there, a divisor of 0, a callee's requires false, or an Int outside
±(2^53−1). z3's result is compared with the body only when the body is
known there.

```ts
function replayHazard(
  program: Program,
  fn: FnUnit,
  kind: i32,
  index: i32,
  cex: Counterexample,
): ReplayResult
```

<scalar-field name="program" type="Program" required>

the program

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="fn" type="FnUnit" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="kind" type="i32" required>

`QUERY_DIV`, `QUERY_PRE` or `QUERY_RANGE`

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="index" type="i32" required>

</scalar-field>

### replayWitness

Replays a `vector diff` witness through both versions: confirmed when a
narrowed witness passes every old requires and fails a new one (a widened
one the reverse), or when a value witness passes both and the bodies
return z3's two results, which differ.

```ts
function replayWitness(
  oldProgram: Program,
  oldFn: FnUnit,
  newProgram: Program,
  newFn: FnUnit,
  kind: i32,
  inputs: Counterexample,
  oldResult: string,
  newResult: string,
): ReplayResult
```

<scalar-field name="oldProgram" type="Program" required>

the old program

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="oldFn" type="FnUnit" required>

the old version of the function

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="newProgram" type="Program" required>

the new program

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="newFn" type="FnUnit" required>

the new version

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="kind" type="i32" required>

`REPLAY_NARROWED`, `REPLAY_WIDENED` or `REPLAY_VALUE`

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="inputs" type="Counterexample" required>

the witness, by the new version's parameter names

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="oldResult" type="string" required>

the old result z3 gave, `?` or "" for none

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="newResult" type="string" required>

the new result z3 gave, `?` or "" for none

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="ReplayResult">

</scalar-field>
